cards.title: Shared identities and local subrings
cards.adjudication_question: Which exact sources use inherited/common identity, and should missing convention evidence remain explicitly deferred?
cards.mathematics_available_now: Individually unital subrings need not share identity; nonzero unital subrings of a field do. Image of a ring map is not always an embedded domain. Inclusion is not domination.
cards.decision_or_verification_needed: Exact source inclusion conventions; no generic inherited-unit rule inferred from a historical seed.
